newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wheat pool price boosted by A$3/t.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wheat pool price boosted by A$3/t.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said it had increased its estimated 1996/97 pool prices for all grades of wheat except durum by A$3.00 a tonne.
The new pool price for benchmark Australian Standard White (ASW) is A$188.00 a tonne.
The pool price for durum remains unchanged, AWB said.
The pool price rises were less the A$5.00 a tonne increase expected by the market.
After a A$5.00 a tonne pool price increase in its last estimate on January 6, the durum number one expected pool price remains steady on A$260.00 a tonne fob.
The next AWB revision of pool returns will be on February 3.
